profile.name: Rekha Devi Chauhan
profile.title: Counselling Psychologist & Behavioural Therapist
bioParagraphs: I’m a counselling psychologist who offers a compassionate, patient-centred space where you can speak openly and feel truly heard. My work is grounded in empathy, curiosity, and respect for your lived experience.
I have experience supporting neurodivergent individuals—including people with ASD, ADHD, and Down Syndrome—and understand that there is no single “right” way to learn, communicate, or grow.
Our sessions move at a pace that feels comfortable for you, with space for silence, questions, and whatever you need to bring.
profile.philosophy: Every individual has the potential to learn and grow at their own pace.
profile.philosophySubtext: Therapy is not about changing who you are. It is about creating enough safety to understand yourself, discover what supports you, and make room for growth that feels authentic.

faqs.a: After booking, you’ll receive a private Google Meet link by email or WhatsApp. At your session time, simply join from a quiet place where you feel comfortable.

faqs.q: What happens in the first session?
faqs.a: The first session is a gentle conversation about what brings you to therapy, what support might feel useful, and any questions you have. There is no pressure to share everything at once.

faqs.q: Do I need to prepare anything?
faqs.a: Not at all. You can arrive exactly as you are. If it helps, you may note down anything you would like to talk about, but this is completely optional.
